hooks.command: if ! command -v devbox >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'devbox not found on PATH — install: curl -fsSL https://get.jetify.com/devbox/install.sh | bash'; exit 0; fi; [ -f devbox.json ] || exit 0; if [ -f .venv/pyvenv.cfg ] && [ .venv/pyvenv.cfg -nt uv.lock ] && [ .venv/pyvenv.cfg -nt pyproject.toml ]; then exit 0; fi; devbox run -- uv sync --all-extras >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
